data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Four concurrent straight cuts through a central point divide the plane into exactly 8 regions, yielding exactly 8 pieces of pizza.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If cuts were not constrained to pass through the exact center, we could rotate them to prevent triple-intersections and reach 11 pieces.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the pizza had a non-circular topology or holes, the count of connected components could differ.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If cuts were curved instead of straight, the central concurrency would not necessarily limit regions to 2n.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Since all four straight cuts pass through the exact center, they all share exactly one common point. Through any point in a plane, at most 2n distinct regions can be formed by n lines (yielding 2n sectors). We can achieve this maximum by ensuring no two cuts overlap entirely (no two cuts share the same angle). Four distinct straight cuts through the center therefore yield 2 * 4 = 8 sectors, which directly correspond to 8 pieces of pizza.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
